constraints.text: 1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10⁴, at most 10⁴ calls to sumRange
constraints.meaning: Up to 10,000 numbers and 10,000 queries on the same array.
constraints.impact: Adding the numbers for every call is O(n) per call, up to 10⁸ in total. Doing the work once in the constructor makes every call O(1).

constraints.meaning: Values can be negative, zero or positive.
constraints.impact: Any prefix sum is at most 10⁴ · 10⁵ = 10⁹ in absolute value, so int is enough for pre and for every answer.

constraints.meaning: Every query is a valid range, left = right is allowed.
constraints.impact: With pre of length n + 1 and pre[0] = 0, sumRange is pre[right + 1] − pre[left] for every valid query, also when left = 0.

bruteForce.summary: keep nums as it is; every sumRange call adds nums[left] + … + nums[right] again. That is O(n) per call, and the same numbers are added again and again.
